question: What is the primary purpose of a run chart in healthcare?

options.A: To display data over time and spot trends
options.B: To manage hospital pharmacy inventory levels
options.D: To calculate staff salaries and hospital budgets

explanation: Run charts track performance metrics sequentially to reveal patterns or changes over time. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h1)

question: Why are run charts particularly useful for ward-level nursing audits?

options.A: They diagnose patient clinical complications directly
options.B: They replace the need for patient case notes
options.C: They automatically purchase new medical equipment
options.D: They require no complex mathematics to interpret

explanation: Their simplicity allows bedside nurses to use and understand them without advanced statistical training. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h1)

question: What does the vertical axis typically display on a run chart?

options.A: The calendar dates of the audit period
options.B: The room numbers of the hospital ward
options.C: The specific measurement value or metric
options.D: The names of the nursing staff on duty

explanation: The Y-axis shows the scale of the variable being measured, like percentages or counts. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h2)

question: How is the median line positioned on a standard run chart?

options.A: At the highest peak value recorded on the graph
options.B: At exactly fifty percent of the vertical axis scale
options.C: To split the plotted data points equally above and below
options.D: At the lowest baseline value recorded on the graph

explanation: The median divides the total number of data points so half are above and half are below it. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h2)

question: What is the recommended minimum number of data points needed for a reliable run chart?
explanation: Gathering at least 10 to 12 sequential points provides enough data to spot valid trends and patterns. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h3)

question: A nurse wants to track delayed drug administration on a medical ward. What is the very first step?

options.A: Draw random lines across a blank sheet of paper
options.B: Punish the nurses who delayed medication delivery
options.C: Buy an expensive computer software program
options.D: Define the specific quality goal and measure

explanation: Constructing any chart begins with clearly defining the exact problem and metric you intend to track. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h3)

question: What type of variation represents predictable, routine background noise in a process?
explanation: Common cause variation is the normal, expected fluctuation built into any routine system. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h4)

question: Why must nurses distinguish between common and special cause variations?

options.A: To determine the exact monthly salary of hospital administrators
options.B: To avoid reacting to normal noise as if it were a major problem
options.C: To assign cleaning duties to junior ward assistants
options.D: To calculate the total drug dosage for pediatric patients

explanation: Treating common cause variation like a special event wastes resources and disrupts stable clinical workflows. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h4)

question: How many consecutive points on one side of the median line constitute a shift?
explanation: A shift is defined as six or more consecutive points falling entirely on one side of the median line. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h5)

question: What pattern defines a trend using the standard run chart interpretation rules?

options.A: Twelve points alternating above and below the median line randomly
options.B: Two identical data points recorded on consecutive days
options.C: Five or more points consistently moving in a single direction
options.D: A single point located far away from the rest of the graph

explanation: A trend consists of five or more consecutive points moving continuously upward or downward. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h5)

question: A clinic nurse manager wants to display infection control data to motivate staff. Where is the best place to use a run chart?

options.A: Locked inside the private drawer of the hospital director
options.B: On the staff notice board for all team members to view
options.C: Printed in an international medical research textbook
options.D: Stored in an encrypted folder on a personal flash drive

explanation: Displaying charts openly on ward notice boards promotes transparency and keeps frontline staff engaged in quality improvement. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h6)

question: Which of the following clinical situations is best monitored using a run chart?

options.A: The physical architectural blueprint of a new hospital building
options.B: The manufacturer brand name of purchased ward stretchers
options.C: The personal employment history of a newly hired nurse
options.D: Daily rates of accidental needle-stick injuries on a surgical ward

explanation: Run charts are designed to track operational clinical metrics and safety events sequentially over time. [learn more](GST319_U1_T3#GST319_U1_T3_h6)
